name: Kanban
summary: Horizontal board of vertically-stacked KanbanColumns containing KanbanCards. Drag-and-drop reorders within a column or between columns; keyboard ArrowKeys + space cycles cards through columns per WCAG 2.5.7. Distinct from List (single column) and DataGrid (tabular). The board scrolls horizontally; each column scrolls vertically inside.

columns.description: Array of { id, title, count?, accentTone? }.

cards.description: Array of { id, columnId, title, body?, assignees?, dueDate?, tags?, severity? }.

onCardMove.description: Fires with { cardId, toColumnId, toIndex } when a card lands in a new position.

wipLimits.description: Map of columnId → number. When exceeded, the column header shows danger-tinted count.

keyboard: Tab - move focus into the board
ArrowLeft / ArrowRight - move focused card to adjacent column
ArrowUp / ArrowDown - move focused card within its column
Space - pick up / drop card (drag-equivalent without pointer)
rules: Per WCAG 2.5.7 — every drag MUST have a keyboard equivalent. Space-to-pick-up + Arrow-to-move + Space-to-drop is the canonical pattern.
Each column is a labelled region (aria-label='{columnTitle}, {count} cards').
Card moves announce via aria-live='polite' — 'Moved Card X from In Progress to Done'.
WIP-limit exceeded: announce via aria-live='polite' on column overflow.
Drop targets carry data-drop-target during drag; visible focus when keyboard-cycling.

do: Render WIP limit as 'N / M' in the column header.
Use column accent tone sparingly — Backlog: neutral, Done: success.
Cards: title + ≤ 2 lines body + bottom row (Avatar + due date + tags + severity).
Open a Drawer (side='right') for card detail; never inline-expand cards.
dont: Don't auto-scroll horizontally on every card move. Only auto-scroll when a card lands in a column off-screen.
Don't render more than 7 columns without horizontal-overflow scrolling and a column-overview FilterBar.

changelog.note: Initial Kanban contract (beta). WCAG 2.5.7 keyboard-drag-equivalent contract.
